details.description: Tong lost guarda
Hydraulic leak coming from a gauge on the unit. Small drip
Broken bollt

Job went very well. We had a delay during the rig up, our api bowl would not fit directly on top of the bop due to large d rings on top of the bop, we had to wait for an adapter to arrive. If we sent air slips in the future the d rings won't be an issue.
He gave me pointers on being in the rig
Drill pipe was obstructing view of v door operator and catwalk operator. They did a good job using hand signals to communicate
Worked together and go through job done
H2S monitors have not been bumped tested since last month.
A discussion was also had about observation card participation and expectations.
A lengthy discussion was had about the recent incident involving a bar to close the elevator. This job was similar so a stand down to discuss expectations a procedure was in order.
While conducting field visit, noticed utility trailer had driver side, front clearance light broken. Please see attachment.
Se quebro la conexion del fierro y se arreglo
Weather possible lightening
Hand using cutting torch without safety glasses
Rainy and wet conditions. Crew did a good job moving around with proper footing
Started with the 250 ton elevators and was just looking out for the weight whenever we got stuck so the driller wouldn't pick up close to the limit to witch to the 500 ton elevators
Pozo con mucha presion de gas.
While hoisting equipment to the rig floor hoist was behind derrick fingers.
CRT trailer straps show signs of age. Please replace
Ski rope on elevator was not what I felt to be in the best position for safe use. Had crew adjust how it was attached.
Roads were wet and location was muddy.  Drive carefully, watch your step and use four wheel drive.
While washing tools form out the pressure washer was leaking water
The pipe roller came into buffer zone without hard hat
Pipe roller was rolling pipe with no hard hat
Bolts on the generator belt guard was lose
Turbo on rig generator is missing heat wrap
